instruction.text: Decide if these statements about triangles are true or false.

atoms.a: All right-angled triangles have a hypotenuse.
The hypotenuse is always on the same side as the right angle.
The hypotenuse is always opposite the right angle.
The hypotenuse is always the longest side of a right-angled triangle.
Which side of this triangle is the hypotenuse?
Which vertex of the triangle is a right angle?

Which vertex of the triangle is a right angle?

atoms.text: The caretaker puts her mop away, leaning it against the wall. With the floor as the final side, this makes a right-angled triangle.

atoms.a: Which sides would form the right angle in this triangle?
Which side of this triangle would be the longest?
